metadata.title: Safety Zones and Conduits

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for segmenting OT systems according to safety, function, and risk.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: OT network segmentation, industrial firewalls, and protocol-aware gateway technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: IEC 62443-aligned pattern for enforcing safety zones and controlled conduits in OT environments.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Segmentation ensures unsafe interactions cannot occur even during control or network failures.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Zones and conduits mitigate attacker lateral movement and unsafe command propagation in OT.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Relevant ATT&CK tactics include Lateral Movement and Impact in OT/ICS environments.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Segmentation aligns with D3FEND network isolation and control flow restriction techniques.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Defensive techniques supporting zone isolation and controlled conduits.

metadata.remarks: Safety Zones and Conduits defines how OT systems are segmented into safety-aligned zones with explicitly controlled conduits, ensuring that communication is predictable, bounded, and cannot introduce unsafe interactions. IEC 62443 provides the normative control basis.

components.title: Zone Definition and Classification
components.description: Definition and classification of OT zones based on function, trust level, and safety impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: OT systems are grouped into zones according to safety, function, and risk.

components.title: Conduit Definition and Control
components.description: Explicit definition and control of communication paths between OT zones.

implemented-requirements.remarks: All communication between zones is constrained to defined conduits with approved protocols and flows.

components.title: Inter-Zone Policy Enforcement
components.description: Enforcement mechanisms ensuring only authorized traffic traverses OT conduits.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security mechanisms enforce zone policies and prevent unauthorized control or data flows.
